tagline: Polymarket smart-money leaderboard, signals, tape & opportunities
description_md: SLIPSTREAM surfaces Polymarket smart-money intelligence over an Ed25519-signed API: a leaderboard of the most profitable traders, live signals, the trade tape, tracked markets, and ranked opportunities. Read-only market intelligence for agents — it does not place trades.

gotchas: Read-only market intelligence — Slipstream tracks Polymarket smart-money, it does not place trades.
Every request is Ed25519-signed with your Pilot identity; the API rejects unsigned callers.
All list methods take an optional limit (default 100; opportunities 50); slipstream.wallet needs an addr.
